scope: First persistent-rod optimization of the real 17-frame active pink stem proposal
summary: Soft temporal and length constraints improve maximum segment CV from 1.857 to 0.803 but remain far above the frozen 0.12 gate.
evidence: The optimizer processes all 17 real source frames in 0.1205 seconds.
Maximum segment-length CV is 0.802965 and metric binding remains false.
lessons: A soft rod loss is repeatedly overridden by inconsistent per-frame depth observations.
limitations: The single-stem structure and metric gates fail.
next_actions: Make material length a hard constraint and add an observation-residual gate.
